claims.text: Nudging interventions are broadly defined as a rearrangement of a choice context that gently suggests a specific choice.
It is unclear to what extent nudging interventions can be transparent without losing effectiveness.
It is unclear how permanent the effects of nudging interventions are.
Nudging harnesses insights from research in psychology to change human behavior.

evidence.description: The authors state that nudging interventions are broadly defined as a rearrangement of a choice context that gently suggests a specific choice.
The authors state that it is yet unclear to what extent nudging interventions can be transparent without losing effectiveness.
The authors note that it remains an unresolved question how permanent the effects of nudges are.
The authors highlight that nudging harnesses insights from decades of research in psychology to change people's behavior.

limitations.text: Missing scientific evidence regarding key questions like transparency and permanence has fueled contentious debates on the ethics of nudging.

future_work.text: Understand the psychological boundary conditions of nudging when applied across varied domains of daily life.
Determine the extent to which nudging interventions can remain transparent without losing effectiveness.
Investigate the temporal permanence and long-term effects of nudging interventions.
